basic_details.job_title: NFSU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Project Manager, Cyber Security Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) under the CFDS Project is recruiting candidates for 6 project-based vacancies, comprising Project Manager, GIS Developer, Full Stack Developer, CAD Engineer, Embedded Engineer, and Cyber Security Engineer posts. These positions are purely on a temporary basis, initially for 12 months and extendable if required. Remuneration is up to Rs. 1,40,000 for Project Manager and up to Rs. 40,000 for the other posts, with qualification requirements varying by post. Eligible candidates can apply online by filling up the application form using the provided Googl

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the requisite educational qualifications for their respective posts as detailed below: Project Manager: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, GIS, Geoinformatics, Artificial Intelligence, Defence Technology or equivalent discipline from a recognized University/Institute OR MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / GIS / Geoinformatics / Artificial Intelligence / Data Science / Remote Sensing) with relevant professional experience. Requires 5-8+ years of experience. Desirable experience includes defense technology programs, software systems, modelling & simulation platforms, UAVs, and Command & Control (C2) environments. GIS Developer: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, GIS, Geoinformatics, Artificial Intelligence, Defence Technology OR MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / GIS / Geoinformatics / Artificial Intelligence / Data Science / Remote Sensing). Requires 0-2+ years of experience in PostgreSQL/PostGIS, QGIS/ArcGIS, Python/JavaScript, and spatial databases. Full Stack Developer: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science OR MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / Information Technology) with relevant experience. Requires 0-2+ years of experience in React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, and relational/NoSQL databases. CAD Engineer: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics & Communication OR MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / Information Technology) with relevant experience. Requires 0-2+ years of experience in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, Fusion 360, 3D modelling, and 2D drafting. Embedded Engineer: B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mechanical Engineer, Electronics & Communication OR MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / Information Technology) with relevant experience. Requires 0-2+ years of experience in embedded hardware/firmware, C/C++, Python, Embedded Linux/RTOS, and microcontrollers. Cyber Security Engineer: MTech in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science. Requires 0-2+ years of experience in defining cybersecurity architecture for C2/C4ISR systems, VAPT, and secure SDLC.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual and project-based under NFSU CFDS Projects for strategic technology and defence-oriented programs. The monthly remuneration is ₹1,40,000/- for the Project Manager and up to ₹40,000/- for all other positions. The remuneration indicated is the maximum amount payable and actual remuneration may be decided or revised based on qualifications, experience, performance in the interview, and suitability. The initial engagement period is 01 year, which is extendable based on project requirements and performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NFSU Project Manager
content_sections.text: Visit the official university website at www.nfsu.ac.in or refer to the recruitment notification. Access the application form through the online Google Form link provided in the notification. Fill up all required details accurately in the online application form. Submit the completed application form on or before the last date, 19th October, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview schedule via email. The selection process may include a Technical Assessment followed by a Personal Interview, as decided by the Selection Committee. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview process.

rows.details: Recruitment Notice for CFDS Project Positions

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: The positions are purely temporary and contractual, established for project-based work for an initial period of one year, which is extendable based on project requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q2. How will candidates be shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview schedule via email, and the selection process may include a Technical Assessment followed by a Personal Interview as decided by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the shortlist and interview details appear?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed directly of the interview schedule via email.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Desirable experience includes working in defence technology programs, leadership of complex projects, hands-on exposure to software systems, modelling & simulation platforms, UAVs, Command & Control (C2) environments, knowledge of GIS, databases, and integrated software architectures.
